title: Voids and refunds
purpose: The rule on voiding orders and giving money back; written with the discount rule after S2.
facts: Unpaid orders may be voided by their advisor with a reason; paid orders only by the shop manager after slot 3 has traced the payment.
Voids keep their lines and totals (design 2.4; ERP mess kind 9).
Refunds return by the original method; cash refunds are counted out by the shop manager and logged; a refund is a refund entry, not a void plus a new order (ERP payment: refund).
Slot 3 reads the void list weekly against the till.
Created the same day as the discount rule.

list_items.item: An order with no payment on it may be voided by the advisor who opened it, with a reason: wrong customer, duplicate, opened by mistake.
An order with a payment on it is never voided at the counter. If it is wrong, the shop manager voids it, with a reason, after Donna has seen where the money went.
A voided order keeps its lines and its totals in the system. Voiding does not make it disappear, and it is not meant to.
Back the way the money came. Card to the same card. Cash to cash.
A cash refund of any size is counted out by the shop manager, not the advisor, and written in the till log.
A refund is entered as a refund against the order. It is never done by voiding the order and writing a new one.

new_facts: The void and refund rules. Reason: the story names voids after payment as the second leak; a written rule lets "does anyone break it today" be asked of voids too. No violation after the rule is planted.
notes_for_russian_writer: Russian equivalent: сторнирование and возврат through the cash register with a return receipt (чек возврата, 54-ФЗ). The Russian leak is work past the order, so add: every job has an order before the car is touched.
